subject: Brightleaf — renewal true-up and capacity top-up reconciliation
messages:
From: Jessica Park <jessica.park@brightleaf.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Cho <aaron.cho@brightleaf.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Usage spike during renewal window — reconciliation ask

Hi Logan,

Quick heads-up from our finance and platform teams: while preparing to sign the renewal amendment for Q4, we discovered a material spike in inference units during the Oct 18–Nov 2 window that wasn’t captured in our previous monthly reports. We traced this back to a misconfigured batch job that re-ran several large queries; approximate extra consumption is ~1.2M tokens (estimated).

We need to reconcile that retroactive usage as part of the renewal. Can Redwood provide a line-item usage export for Oct 18–Nov 2 and a proposal for a one-time settlement? Brightleaf prefers a single one-off invoice rather than adjusting committed capacity if possible.

I’ve attached our exported logs (brightleaf_usage_oct-nov2026.csv) for your reference.

Thanks — can you confirm next steps and an ETA on the bill? We’d like to close this before the amendment gets routed for signature.

Best,
Jessica Park
Head of Platform Operations
Brightleaf Labs
attachments: brightleaf_usage_oct-nov2026.csv
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica.park@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage spike during renewal window — reconciliation ask

Thanks for the note, Jessica — and thanks for attaching the logs. Apologies for the disruption; we’ll get this reconciled quickly so your renewal can proceed on schedule.

Proposed immediate plan (short action list):
- I’ll ask Finance to prepare a one-time invoice for the excess usage (Marissa, cc’d).
- Mina (CS) will validate the attribution to the batch job and confirm whether any request-level credits are appropriate.
- I’ll prepare an amendment (one-off top-up line) to attach to the renewal for signature once finance confirms the amount.

Can you confirm Brightleaf’s preferred payment terms for this type of invoice (net 30 / net 15)? If you prefer DocuSign routing, we’ll prepare the amendment and invoice links together.

For transparency, copying in Ben to flag for account credits/discount consideration on renewal.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica.park@brightleaf.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage spike during renewal window — proposed settlement and invoice

Hi Jessica / team —

Thanks for the logs, Jessica. We’ve cross-referenced Brightleaf’s exported usage against our token accounting; confirmed excess usage of 1,192,400 tokens in the stated window (Oct 18–Nov 2). Below is our proposed reconciliation: 

- Unit rate applied: $0.0016 per 1k tokens (hosted API standard rate for Brightleaf cohort)
- Calculated one-time charge: $1,907.84 (rounded to $1,908)
- Administrative/invoice handling fee: $25 (one-time)
- Total one-off invoice: $1,933.00

Options we can offer: 
1) One-time invoice (preferred by Brightleaf) — invoice_4882_oneoff.pdf attached; Net 30 default.
2) Apply as 1-time credit against the renewal invoice (if you want the amount netted).
3) Split across two invoices (if finance requests).

If you accept option 1, we’ll issue the invoice today and route the amendment for signature (DocuSign link included on approval). If you want a small concession given the configuration cause, Ben can propose a courtesy 10% discount on the one-time charge (would reduce total to $1,739.70) — let me know if that’s needed.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
attachments: invoice_4882_oneoff.pdf

Hi Marissa / Logan,

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear breakdown. Brightleaf is fine with option 1 (one-time invoice) on Net 30 — we’d appreciate the 10% goodwill discount if Ben is comfortable authorizing it given origin was a misconfiguration on our side. If you can update the invoice to $1,739.70 we’ll route payment upon acceptance.

Please include the amended renewal amendment in the DocuSign bundle so our legal team can sign both documents together.

Best,
Jessica

Subject: Final: settlement amount and DocuSign bundle

Jessica — great, thank you. Ben has approved the 10% courtesy discount. We will: 
- Re-issue invoice_4882_oneoff.pdf updated to $1,739.70 (attached).
- Add a single amendment line to the renewal and bundle both documents in DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc-123).
- Route to Brightleaf legal for signature; once signed, we’ll mark the deal in HubSpot (deal RDW-GB-2026-4882) and Finance will issue payment instructions.

Mina — please confirm attribution work is complete on your side and note any service notes we should include in the amendment wording.

Jessica — expect the DocuSign bundle and updated invoice within the hour. Appreciate the quick collaboration — we’ll get this closed so renewal timing is unaffected.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: signed_amendment_brightleaf_q4_2026.pdf, invoice_4882_oneoff.pdf
